overview: 56 official Qs (2008, 2012, 2017, 2019, 2024, 2025); 2025 Mains has 27. Climate treaties and India's role (13), sustainable development and SDGs (13) and disease burden (11) lead. Mostly one-liners on 'what/which/primary aim', dates and counts; 2024-25 add A-R, NOT-questions and statement sets (SDG Index, GRCA).

possibility.what_they_ask: GHG from lowland paddy (methane), nature of black carbon, cause of glacier melt, incorrect statement on CO2 and deforestation

possibility.angle: Climate change: emitters and tipping points
possibility.what_they_ask: Largest developing-world CO2 emitter (China), tipping point example (Arctic ice loss)

possibility.evidence: Not yet asked as its own leaf in Group 2
possibility.what_they_ask: Natural targets: SO2 and NOx as causes, pH below 5.6, marble cancer (Taj Mahal), coal power and vehicles as sources
Main cause of ozone hole (CFCs), Kigali amends Montreal, A-R on CFC effects vs uses

possibility.evidence: Not yet asked in Group 2; asked in other APPSC exams (effect on shell formation)
possibility.what_they_ask: Natural targets: CO2 absorption lowers ocean pH, carbonate shells and corals weakened
Paris basis (NDCs) and legal nature of targets, Rio 1992 outputs, which agreement is not about GHGs, GHG satellite country, Ozone Day and Environment Day dates

possibility.what_they_ask: INDC target figures, NAPCC mission count and aim, first carbon-neutral airport, per-capita emissions, GRCA statements

Types of epidemic, disease whose vector is not a mosquito

Uddanam kidney centre place, Drugs and Magic Remedies Act scope, ABDM components, target group of PM-JAY, sanitation campaign name

traps.trap: Climate treaty vs ozone/waste treaty swap [which problem?]
traps.spot: Options mix Kyoto/Paris with Montreal, Basel, Bali
traps.fix: Kigali (2016) amends Montreal (HFCs); Basel = hazardous waste; Doha amended Kyoto

traps.trap: Ozone gas vs greenhouse gas swap
traps.fix: Ozone hole = chlorine/bromine from CFCs and halons; CO2 and CH4 drive warming

traps.spot: Statement saying an activity decreases CO2
traps.fix: Deforestation removes a sink and adds CO2
traps.pyq: 'Deforestation is decreasing the amount of CO2' is the incorrect statement [mains-2025-paper2#149]

traps.trap: Binding procedure confused with binding targets
traps.spot: 'Legally bound by targets' with big emitters as options
traps.fix: Paris NDCs are nationally determined, targets not legally binding; Kyoto had binding Annex I targets
traps.pyq: 'United States and China' → None of these [mains-2025-paper2#101]; Paris → NDCs [prelims-2017#140]

traps.fix: China largest total; India 3rd total but lowest per capita among big emitters
traps.pyq: Developing-world largest polluter → China [mains-2017-paper3#33]; lowest per capita 2012 → India [mains-2019-paper3#14]

traps.trap: Scheme component borrowed from a sister scheme
traps.spot: NOT-question on ABDM or PM-JAY parts
traps.fix: ABDM: ABHA, HPR, HFR, Sandbox; Arogya Mitra belongs to PM-JAY

traps.spot: 'Viral disease' among bacterial and protozoan ones
traps.fix: Herpes viral; typhoid, diphtheria bacterial; malaria protozoan
Kala-azar (leishmaniasis) = sandfly; dengue/chikungunya = Aedes; malaria = Anopheles

traps.trap: Extreme word in a definition option
traps.fix: SD and circular economy are about balance and reuse; test the fact behind the extreme word
traps.pyq: 'focuses exclusively on reducing carbon emissions' → reuse, recycle, repair [mains-2025-paper2#109]; 'Only greenhouse gas emissions' → mitigation and adaptation [mains-2025-paper2#99]

traps.trap: Uses offered as the explanation of effects
traps.spot: A-R where R lists where something is used
traps.fix: Uses (refrigerants, aerosols) do not explain why CFCs warm the climate and deplete ozone
traps.pyq: Both true, R not the explanation [mains-2025-paper2#147]

techniques.name: Treaty-to-problem map [one problem per treaty]
techniques.how: Tag each treaty with its problem: UNFCCC/Kyoto/Paris climate; Vienna/Montreal/Kigali ozone (+HFCs); Basel waste; CBD biodiversity. The odd tag answers NOT-questions.
techniques.example: 'Agenda 21 and Rio Declaration' → Earth Summit 1992; Kyoto/Paris/WHA are other events [mains-2025-paper2#110]

techniques.name: Date chain for SD milestones
techniques.how: Stockholm 1972 (5 June Environment Day) → Brundtland 1987 → Rio 1992 → MDGs 2000 → SDGs 2015 (17). Place the stem on the chain.
techniques.example: SD 'first popularised' → Brundtland 1987; Rio came later [mains-2025-paper2#104]

techniques.name: Mechanism over association
techniques.how: Pick the option naming the causal mechanism, not something merely linked.
techniques.example: Mosquitoes resisting DDT → resistant variants survive → natural selection [mains-2017-paper1#28]

techniques.name: Count recall with neighbours
techniques.how: Remember counts with their neighbours to reject near numbers: 8 MDGs (3 health), 17 SDGs/169 targets, 8 NAPCC missions.

techniques.name: Statement-by-statement check with a location anchor
techniques.how: Verify the venue/date clause first; a wrong venue kills that statement and its codes.
techniques.example: GRCA launched at COP28 Dubai, not New Delhi → statement I false → II and III only [prelims-2024#106]

techniques.name: Age-band definitions
techniques.how: Neonatal <28 days, infant <1 year, under-five <5 years; MMR per 1 lakh live births.

confusions.remember: Ozone (CFCs; Kigali adds HFCs) vs GHG emission targets
Kigali amends Montreal; Doha amends Kyoto
Top-down binding vs self-set, not legally binding
Land and water area needed vs GHG emitted
Protein deficit with oedema vs overall energy deficit with wasting
Digital health IDs and registries vs Rs 5 lakh hospital cover with Arogya Mitras
Objectionable advertisements vs manufacture and sale
First carbon-neutral in Asia-Pacific vs first fully solar-powered

Total vs per capita; binding vs non-binding
Cause or effect? Sink or source?
Check the venue/date clause in statement sets first
Pathogen class and vector: confirm both
Does the scheme component belong to this scheme or its sister?
